property_summary: Calling C.transfer returns true and only succeeds (does not revert) when the _tos array is non-empty and every external call to caddress.transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v) succeeds; otherwise the call reverts — so the test asserts that if transfer does not revert then it returned true.
If C.transfer returns (i.e., does not revert), it always returns true for any non-empty _tos input.
For any non-empty _tos and any inputs, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., it never returns false) — the test asserts that if it returns then the returned value is true.

If transfer executes without reverting, it makes at least one external call to caddress (i.e., _tos.length>0 implies the function returns true and did not short-circuit), so when non-reverting the returned value is true and _tos.length remains > 0 beforehand.
